description: This file defines Punjabi (India) culture information for the Date.js library, including date formats, day and month names, regex patterns, and parsing functions.

methods.name: Date.today
methods.description: Returns the current date with time cleared.

methods.name: Date.parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object based on culture-specific formats.

methods.name: Date.getParseFunction
methods.description: Returns a parsing function for a given format.

methods.name: Date.parseExact
methods.description: Parses a date string with an exact format.
